title: Writer Technology Infinite Canvas Lsp
description: Create a new writer technology: full-blown text editor on infinite canvas (Vello/WebGPU via infinite/cavas), real JSON-RPC LSP client/server in Web Worker, writer playground with jack fixture, jack language server (lint/format/hover/completion), integrate WriterCanvas into trinity/jack shell replacing CodeEditor.
summary: Implemented the writer technology: infinite-canvas GPU editor (writer/rs on infinite_cavas), language-agnostic LSP client (writer/core), WriterCanvas React component (writer/react), writer playground with jack fixture (writer/play), Jack language service extensions (lint/format/hover/semantic_tokens in trinity/jack/core), Jack LSP WASM server (trinity/jack/lsp), framework integration (UiWriterHostSurfaceNode, bootWriterPlay), and replaced CodeEditor in trinity/jack shell with WriterCanvas + jack LSP. Registered dev port 6062, launch.json, workspaces. Tests: trinity_jack 16, trinity_jack_lsp 2, writer 3, writer-core 4, writer-react 6, writer-play 5, trinity-jack-play 16.
